name: Console commands help
description: Help mode entries for the Console commands plugin (help@1): its settings tab, the open consoles list and the last commands.
author: Brett

entries.title: Console commands settings
entries.text: Lets a Claude session (Amber), the REST API or the CLI open screens, dialogs and settings tabs in this console, run its actions and go back. Opening only moves the screen; an action that changes data still needs its own permission, and one that deletes or resets needs a confirm.

entries.title: Let Claude sessions move this console
entries.text: On: this console listens for console commands and goes where they say. Off: it stops listening, and commands go to your other open consoles.

entries.title: Show a note for each command
entries.text: Shows a short note each time a command moves this console, saying who asked and what opened.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reloads the apps, the open clients and the last commands from the console server.

entries.title: Apps on the surface
entries.text: Every app on the framework that Claude sessions can drive (the Dev Console, AmberX, axHub web, Molly, and any app whose client is connected): whether it is open right now, where it is, and how many screens, settings tabs, dialogs and actions it reports. Amber opens them with app_show, app_open and friends; the CLI with axf app <app> …

entries.title: Let Claude sessions move this console
entries.text: On: this console listens for console commands and goes where they say. Off: it stops listening, and commands go to your other open consoles.

entries.title: Show a note for each command
entries.text: Shows a short note each time a command moves this console, saying who asked and what opened.

entries.title: Wake the console through AmberX when it's closed
entries.text: On: a console command that finds no open console waits on the server, and after a few seconds AmberX on your phone opens the console so the command runs. Off: the command waits for you to open a console yourself.

entries.title: How long a command waits for a console
entries.text: How long a waiting command stays in the queue. After this it is dropped, so a command never runs late.

entries.title: Browser AmberX opens
entries.text: Which browser AmberX uses when it wakes the console: Chrome, or the phone's default browser.
